The Acer Aspire Lite 15 AL15-52 is the best pick if you want 16GB RAM, and the Acer Aspire 15 Lite AL15-41 is the cheapest with a Ryzen 5.

Acer Aspire Lite 15 AL15-52	₹49,990	12th Gen Core i3	16GB / 512GB SSD	Not listed (name says 15)
Cheapest: Acer AL15-41, and it still has a Ryzen 5.
Newest chip: Dell DC15255, a Ryzen 5 7520U that is a newer generation than the 5625U.
Most RAM: Acer AL15-52 has double the RAM, but a weaker Core i3 and a price right at your limit.

The source page (Smartprix) does not list screen details, so check size and panel type before buying. All three come with Windows 11.
